meta.greeting: Welcome home. I kept the lamp on.
meta.rationale: A warm evening flat: the lamp on, the sofa waiting, the city at the window, and the two of you counting the days.
meta.theme-about: cosy evening apartment, cute and warm: a full-screen canvas of a little living room at night (cream wallpaper with tiny hearts, a wooden floor, a navy sofa with a red cushion, a glowing floor lamp, a window of city lights and a moon, a small TV humming blue), the companion in a round portrait frame on the wall with a red ribbon, a sticky-note card with the time and the days together, the apps as fridge-magnet tiles on a cork strip; scarlet and navy on cream, rounded and soft. Coming home. (#room, #portrait, #note, #magnets)

desktop.canvas: local function heart(x, y, s, c) g.circle(x - s * 0.5, y, s * 0.55, c); g.circle(x + s * 0.5, y, s * 0.55, c) g.poly({x - s * 1.02, y + s * 0.15, x + s * 1.02, y + s * 0.15, x, y + s * 1.2}, c) end function draw(w, h, t) local floor = h * 0.74 -- wallpaper: cream, soft stripes and tiny hearts g.gradient(0, 0, w, floor, "#f8ece4", "#f0dcd2") for x = 0, w, 64 do g.rect(x, 0, 30, floor, "#ffffff22") end for y = 40, floor - 40, 90 do for x = 32, w, 128 do heart(x + (y % 180 == 40 and 64 or 0), y, 5, "#e8a9b244") end end -- the window: city at night, a moon local wx, wy, ww, wh = w * 0.08, h * 0.16, w * 0.2, h * 0.32 g.rect(wx - 10, wy - 10, ww + 20, wh + 20, "#b0784e", 6) g.gradient(wx, wy, ww, wh, "#1c2147", "#4a3d78") g.circle(wx + ww * 0.75, wy + wh * 0.22, 16, "#fff3cf") g.glow(wx + ww * 0.75, wy + wh * 0.22, 46, "#fff3cf55") for i = 0, 11 do local bx = wx + (i * 37) % ww local bh = 30 + (i * 23) % 70 g.rect(bx, wy + wh - bh, 26, bh, "#2a2f55") for k = 0, 3 do if math.floor(t * 0.5 + i + k) % 4 ~= 0 then g.rect(bx + 6, wy + wh - bh + 8 + k * 14, 5, 6, "#ffd36b") end end end g.rect(wx + ww / 2 - 3, wy, 6, wh, "#b0784e"); g.rect(wx, wy + wh / 2 - 3, ww, 6, "#b0784e") -- the floor g.gradient(0, floor, w, h - floor, "#b9825a", "#8f5e3e") for x = 0, w, 120 do g.line(x, floor, x - 60, h, "#7a4e3244", 2) end -- a lamp, glowing local lx = w * 0.84 g.glow(lx, floor - 300, 180 + 8 * math.sin(t * 1.3), "#ffd59a66") g.rect(lx - 3, floor - 290, 6, 290, "#2a2f55") g.poly({lx - 46, floor - 290, lx + 46, floor - 290, lx + 30, floor - 350, lx - 30, floor - 350}, "#ffe7c4") g.rect(lx - 30, floor - 6, 60, 10, "#2a2f55", 5) -- the sofa, a red cushion local sx, sw = w * 0.32, w * 0.36 g.rect(sx, floor - 150, sw, 90, "#2a2f55", 26) g.rect(sx - 26, floor - 120, 60, 120, "#232849", 22); g.rect(sx + sw - 34, floor - 120, 60, 120, "#232849", 22) g.rect(sx + 10, floor - 80, sw - 20, 70, "#343a6a", 20) g.rect(sx + sw * 0.6, floor - 132, 80, 62, "#d8344a", 18) heart(sx + sw * 0.6 + 40, floor - 108, 8, "#ffffffaa") -- a small TV, its blue light breathing local tx = w * 0.70 g.glow(tx + 70, floor - 40, 110, string.format("#5fa8ff%02x", math.floor(40 + 20 * math.sin(t * 2)))) g.rect(tx, floor - 98, 140, 86, "#1b1e3a", 10); g.rect(tx + 8, floor - 90, 124, 70, "#3a6fd8", 6) g.rect(tx + 50, floor - 12, 40, 12, "#1b1e3a", 4) -- the rug g.rect(w * 0.3, floor + 40, w * 0.4, 40, "#d8344a55", 20) end
